title: Figures 79-80: Tic Tac CFD Mach number at 500 mph and pressure at 900 mph
description: Two color CFD contour plots of the capsule-shaped "Tic Tac" body at 1/6 scale with numeric color legends. Captions read "Figure 79. Tic Tac Mach Number at 1/6 Scale, Air Temperature 223K and 500 mph with Mixed Inlet and Subsonic Outlet" and "Figure 80. Tic Tac Pressure at 1/6 Scale, Air Temperature 223K and 900 mph with Supersonic Inlet and Supersonic Outlet," the latter showing a curved shock front ahead of the nose (in Pa). Attachment II, page 123 of the BAASS report.
